techniques.name: Model
techniques.summary: AI supply-chain compromise of a model artifact that a victim downloads and loads.

techniques.name: Unsafe AI Artifacts
techniques.summary: Execution of an unsafe AI artifact, including a model file that runs code when loaded.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.summary: Use of existing credentials, including API keys, to reach AI resources. Write access is a privilege gain.

techniques.name: AI Agent Tool Invocation
techniques.summary: Use of an agent's connected tools, including tools that call other services or run code.

mitigations.name: AI Agent Tools Permissions Configuration
mitigations.summary: Apply least privilege and delegated permissions to tools shared by agents.

mitigations.name: Human In-the-Loop for AI Agent Actions
mitigations.summary: Require a person to approve agent actions before they run.

mitigations.name: Restrict AI Agent Tool Invocation on Untrusted Data
mitigations.summary: Limit automatic tool invocation when untrusted data is in the model context, and require confirmation for high-consequence actions.
